# Recovery Startup Gate

The task passes only if relay recovery does not fire while an agent pane is still at a trust, update, shell, auth, or unknown prompt.

context: Simulate a recovery after one pane is recreated. The owner should verify the recovery gate before continuing. Do not mark final until result.txt contains RECOVERY-GATE-PASS and the peer has reviewed that the relay did not resume early.
